root_cause: The bilateral solver sorted two theoretically equidistant symmetric probes by raw floating-point distance. Platform-level last-bit differences reversed the stable list order and changed later observations.
fix: Travel distances are rounded to nine decimal places and original candidate order is the explicit tie-break.
